name: Knot Island Harbour & Town
summary: Arrive on Knot Island (One Island) via the Cinnabar Island ferry. Visit the Pokémon Center to meet Bebe and Celio's assistant searching for their missing Network Adapter. Stop by the Move Export House and the Triple Battle Lounge, and pick up hidden Heart Scales along the beach dock.

items.name: Heart Scale
items.method: Hidden in shallow water between the beach and ferry dock

items.name: Heart Scale
items.method: Hidden in a box south of the Triple Battle Lounge

items.name: Box Link
items.method: Gifted by Bebe in the Pokémon Center after delivering the Network Adapter from Treasure Beach
